div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 776px; height: 1px; padding-top: 840px; margin-left: 34px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

div.div:
Why CDC on the signal table is required
Debezium controls the writes, but a successful INSERT does not prove that the CDC reader has reached that point. Seeing OPEN and CLOSE in the same source stream as Outbox changes creates the ordering boundary used for deduplication.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 791px; height: 1px; padding-top: 840px; margin-left: 904px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Result for the example
The destination receives the newer live row 42 event, not its older snapshot READ. Unchanged rows are emitted as READ events after CLOSE. Streaming never pauses.
